market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain under pressure from 10Y yield at 2007 high and oil volatility around $100. Two Fed hikes now priced in. Tech/AI names provide selective support but broad indices (Dow -300, S&P/Nasdaq down) reflect risk-off. Trump-Xi summit and Iran talks are the dominant near-term catalysts. Expect continued whipsaw; volatility elevated. Biotech and rate-sensitive sectors underperform.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (AWS $496B backlog, Renishaw records, Anthropic launches) supports structural tech outperformance. Rising rates compress multiples but benefit financials. Oil above $100 sustains inflation, delaying Fed pivot. US-China resolution would be a major positive catalyst. Crypto maturing with regulatory cleanup. Housing market faces headwinds from sustained higher rates. EV market structurally weaker post-tax-credit elimination.
